card.name: Countable nouns after each or number
card.fires_on: The noun that ends a counted or quantified phrase, such as syringe(s), slider, cities, studies or province, after words like each, one, of those or a number of. It is often the last piece of the word "syringe".

modes.label: Syringe and device parts
modes.description: The end of syringe or syringes in dosing and preparation instructions, or a named device part such as slider.

modes.label: Counted general nouns
modes.description: A plural or singular noun that follows each, one, those or a number of in ordinary prose.
modes.example: only 4 of those<< studies>>, which included a total of 1
